title: Runaway Temperature
fullDescription:
F10 on Electrolux ovens means the control detected runaway temperature. Immediate shutdown protects the oven and home.

Usually a failed sensor or welded relay.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed part
fixSteps.instruction: Sensor or control board as needed.

title: Shorted Keypad
fullDescription: F11 signals a keypad short. Replace touchpad overlay typically resolves it.

title: Control Communication Error
shortDescription: EOC and user interface lost communication.
fullDescription:
F12 means the electronic oven control cannot communicate with the user interface board.

Reseat cables before replacing boards.

title: Internal Check Sum Error
fullDescription: F13 indicates the control board memory is corrupt. EOC must be replaced.

title: EEPROM Error
fullDescription: F14 indicates EEPROM failure. The board cannot save settings. Typically requires board replacement.

title: User Interface Error
fullDescription: F15 reports a problem in the user interface board. Usually requires UI board replacement.

title: Meat Probe Error
fullDescription: F16 indicates the meat probe is inserted but not reading correctly. Could be probe or jack.

title: Door Lock Motor Fault
shortDescription: Door lock motor failed to engage.
fullDescription: F20 indicates the self-clean door lock motor did not engage within expected time. Replace latch assembly if persists.

title: Door Unlock Fault
fullDescription: F25 means after self-clean the door latch did not unlock. Must cool and mechanically check latch.

title: Open Temperature Probe
fullDescription: F30 indicates the oven temperature sensor circuit is open. Sensor or wiring has failed.

title: Shorted Temperature Probe
fullDescription: F40 is a shorted sensor fault. Replace RTD probe.

faq.a: Yes with basic tools and care.

title: Motherboard Error
fullDescription: F50 indicates a motherboard internal error. Typically requires full EOC replacement.

faq.a: Power cycle may help briefly but won't fix.
